name: Gawhar Shad
role: Chief consort of Shah Rukh, the emperor of the Timurid Empire

checks.lead: Gawhar Shad (Persian: گوهرشاد, romanized: Gawaršād; meaning "joyful jewel" or "shining jewel"; also Gawhar Shad Begum, Gohar Shād or Gawharshâd; died 19 July 1457) was the chief consort of Shah Rukh, the emperor of the Timurid Empire.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
